summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a Rule 424(b)(5) preliminary pricing supplement (Amendment No. 1, dated October 2, 2026) for $1,000-per-note Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due November 1, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq-100 and Russell 2000. Coupon is $7.08 monthly, contingent on each observation value clearing its barrier, with monthly autocall from October 2027. Notes are senior unsecured Series A MTN obligations. This is a routine structured note takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing date October 28, 2026 and aggregate principal.
